title: Orders cannot resolve the payments hostname
query: The gateway returns 502 and orders can't resolve the payments hostname. The payments container isn't running.
root_cause: The payments container is not running.

remediation.detail: Start or restart the payments service.

evidence: Orders logs payment failed with a name resolution error
The payments target is down and the container is stopped
Gateway logs show orders call failed
query_paraphrase: The gateway is returning 502s, orders keeps failing to look up the payments host, and the payments container isn't up.
